summary: Polygon's curated list of the best comedy movies available to stream at home, arguing that comedy has been neglected by Hollywood in recent years. Each pick gets a short writeup with year, runtime, director, cast, and where to watch across Netflix, Prime Video, Max, Hulu, and free services. The latest update added The Road to El Dorado as an editor's pick, and the list spans silent-era classics to 2020 releases.
one_line: Polygon's list of the best streaming comedy movies, from The Gold Rush to The Road to El Dorado, with availability on each service.
key_facts: Polygon's list was published 2023-10-16 and compiles the best comedies on Netflix, Hulu, Prime Video, HBO Max, and free services.
The latest update added The Road to El Dorado (2000) as an editor's pick; it streams on Netflix.
The Road to El Dorado stars Kevin Kline, Kenneth Branagh, and Rosie Perez and has an Elton John soundtrack; it failed in theaters but became a cult classic and meme source.
Charade (1963), directed by Stanley Donen, stars Cary Grant and Audrey Hepburn, whose 25-year age gap led to script rewrites making Reggie the pursuer.
Clueless (1995), directed by Amy Heckerling, transposes Jane Austen's Emma to 1990s Beverly Hills with Alicia Silverstone as Cher.
Eega (2012), from RRR and Baahubali director S.S. Rajamouli, is about a murdered man reincarnated as a fly seeking revenge, and streams on Netflix.
The Gold Rush (1925) is Charlie Chaplin's Klondike comedy featuring the Little Tramp and the fork dance; it streams on Max and Criterion Channel.
Kiss Kiss Bang Bang (2005), directed by Shane Black, stars Robert Downey Jr. as Harry Lockhart and is called the blueprint for Black's 2016 film The Nice Guys.
Spy (2015), directed by Paul Feig, stars Melissa McCarthy as a CIA desk worker and was newly added to Max.
Wheels on Meals (1984), directed by Sammo Hung, features Jackie Chan fighting kickboxer Benny Urquidez in a six-minute fight scene, and the writer also recommends Project A.
The Unauthorized Bash Brothers Experience (2019), a 30-minute Lonely Island spoof of Beyoncé's Lemonade about Jose Canseco and Mark McGwire, streams on Netflix.
Moonstruck (1987) stars Cher and Nicolas Cage, and its egg-in-a-hole dish is nicknamed 'Moonstruck Eggs'.
To Be or Not to Be (1942), directed by Ernst Lubitsch, follows actors in occupied Warsaw tricking Nazis, and streams on Max and Criterion Channel.
